doc.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 9, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Haircuts, reopening rules and colleges deciding about fall
summary: Banter about haircuts and Cuomo's reopening requirements, then how Hamilton and prospective students face college decisions.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Wait until you go get a haircut.
I know. I need one actually.
I finally got one and the hoops they have to jump through, like they test your temperature first. It’s bizarre.
Was the person wearing a mask that gave you the haircut?

And they, as much as we like Cuomo, most of us anyway, I mean he seemed to have acted like an adult, but the business owners are aggravated at the 30 pages of requirements that they’re dealing with to open up. So there’s no good answers and currently the colleges are trying to figure out what to do.

The last I heard they’re planning on the students coming back with some big changes, yet to be determined. And faculty may not want to come back. They have to give the faculty the choice of teaching on campus or off.

Yeah. I was also thinking, you know I have a couple of students that want to go to college next year. And it’s such a strange time. Because do you pay for housing? You don’t know what’s going to happen. It’s so late in the day really, to make a decision like that.
